name: Apply transformations to T1w
summary: Applies an existing ANTs or FSL transform (affine plus optional nonlinear warp) to a T1-weighted image with ANTs antsApplyTransforms, resampling it onto a chosen reference image.
description: Wraps antsApplyTransforms to move a T1w image into another space using a precomputed transform (warp, inverse warp and affine). The reference grid is the first optional fixed input provided, in the order T1w, T2w, parcellation, mask, DWI, b0; at least one must be given. FLIRT/FNIRT transforms can be converted to ITK format first (fsl_transform), and the inverse or affine-only chain can be applied. It does not estimate a registration; use a registration App to compute the transform first.

inputs.description: Precomputed transform: nonlinear warp, inverse warp and affine matrix (ANTs format, or FSL FLIRT/FNIRT when fsl_transform is set).
inputs.requirements: The warp matching the chosen direction must be present unless affine_only is set.

inputs.description: Optional T1w image used as the reference grid (first choice).
Optional T2w image used as the reference grid if no T1w reference is given.
Optional parcellation used as the reference grid if no T1w/T2w reference is given.
Optional mask used as the reference grid if no earlier reference is given.
Optional DWI used as the reference grid if no earlier reference is given.
Optional b0 image used as the reference grid if no other reference is given.

outputs.description: The T1w image resampled into the reference space (NIfTI, same file name as the input).

parameters.description: If true, converts affine and warp to from FSL to ANTs-compatible format

failure_modes.message: Error: No valid anatomical reference found in config.json
failure_modes.cause: None of the optional fixed (reference) inputs was provided.
failure_modes.fix: Provide at least one reference image (T1w, T2w, parcellation, mask, DWI or b0).

failure_modes.message: Error: affine_only is false but appropriate warp is missing
failure_modes.cause: The transform lacks the warp (or inverse warp when inverse is set).
failure_modes.fix: Provide a transform with the needed warp or set affine_only.
